_comment: Green Target legacy debtor code -> greentarget.customers mapping (handover R6). Created in G3 alongside the chart-of-accounts load, which created the 28 debtor accounts from the GTDB LEDGER sections - never from greentarget.customers. This file records which of them additionally have an ERP customer; live invoice entry does not consume it, but the snapshot-less legacy revenue fallback does.
rules: R6: the legacy ledger is the authority for who owes Green Target money. These 28 accounts are import-owned.

Any future debtor sync must be NON-DESTRUCTIVE: it may never delete or rename an import-owned child, and it may not mint a child for an ERP customer that has no ledger presence without explicit approval.
A mapping is only usable once approved:true. G3 approved nothing; the user approved PAUMIN and NURI on 31 Jul 2026 and left SUTERA unapproved.
Handover question 4: the TH debtor is Tien Hock Food Ind. S/B. The two companies are INDEPENDENT - never auto-post one company document into the other ledger; reconcile by hand.
status: SUPERSEDED as the live authority (GT-P1, 30 Jul 2026). PAUMIN (customer 17) and NURI (customer 22) were approved by the user on 31 Jul 2026 (handover 10i, GT-P4 decision 4) and are recorded below for the audit trail. SUTERA (customer 20) remains unapproved and inexact. 3 of 28 legacy debtors have an ERP candidate; 25 have none.
_supersededBy: The live receivable for a Green Target invoice is greentarget.invoices.debtor_account_code (snapshotted per invoice), defaulted from greentarget.customers.debtor_account_code. Approving a mapping now means setting those columns, not editing this file.

resolveGTReceivableAccount/resolveGTLegacyRevenueAccount in src/routes/greentarget/accounting/sales-journal.js consult this file only for snapshot-less legacy compatibility. Current invoice creation uses its explicit snapshots; an old CN/DN whose invoice has no organic/imported journal or revenue snapshot deliberately uses the approved legacy mapping before the B-tong/TGA fallback. Editing approved:true here can therefore change that old-invoice fallback and requires evidence.
Only dev/import/greentarget-legacy/backfill-july-automatic-journals.mjs still reads this file; it reports the approved flag but never gates on it.
